findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-topology.ts:635 mode-dependent status derivation downgrades missing/partial/unsupported basis to status=warn in observe/warn, but returns inconclusive only in enforce because status branches on blocking. This violates B98B0-M1-E-NONPASS-BASIS and B98B0-M1-E-MODES: basis incompleteness must remain INCONCLUSIVE and the canonical evaluation result must be mode-invariant; only blocking may differ. The focused mode loop exercises only clean complete bases, so it cannot detect this regression. Derive status from structural/basis semantics independently of mode, then derive blocking from mode, and add failing-basis assertions across observe/warn/enforce.
findings.resolvedReason: de9bd226 makes canonical status/diagnostics mode-invariant; round-2 quality RR-005 / RP-003 independently verified build and process-fact contract PASS.

findings.desc: doc-code-drift: Wave 2 is documented as leaving measured rollout for Wave 4 and the authoritative execution plan forbids enabling enforce before measured criteria are approved, but transition-orchestrator immediately consumes proofStory.devGateMode and this repository already sets that flat project value to enforce. Thus merging this Story activates the new topology blocker project-wide now, contradicting docs/CLI.md:463-464 and the execution-plan rollout boundary/non-goal; the B-98b0 decision did not account for the pre-existing enforce value. Repro: lattice.config.json:30-33 plus packages/main/src/handlers/transition-orchestrator.ts:468-485; node bin/lattice.js acceptance_topology_check --storyId=B-98b0 --json reports mode=enforce and blocking=true. Resolve with an explicit rollout-safe activation consistent with the plan (or a documented human approval plus measured criteria), then make CLI guidance state the actual activation boundary.

packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-acceptance-topology-gate-smoke.ts:285-319 — B98B0-M3-E-MODE-LIFECYCLE and B98B0-M4-A-REAL-MUTATIONS are not actually proven. The mode loop exercises only a structurally passing report in observe/warn/enforce, and the sole real story_advance case is an enforce-mode clean pass. There is no same failing topology/basis report shown non-blocking in observe/warn and blocking in enforce through the real PLAN→DEV consumer, nor a mode-bypass mutation that makes that assertion fail. The focused smoke therefore remains PASS if enforce stops blocking failures, despite 25/25 evidence claiming this behavior.

packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-acceptance-topology-gate-smoke.ts:257-304 — the 25/25 verificationEvidence overstates the focused smoke coverage. The source covers one command-ref omission, one invented ref, one partial/adapter-pop tamper, and rootDir freshness drift, but the must intents also enumerate missing/unsupported/closure-stale/signature or receipt tamper/aggregate tamper/required-adapter-missing basis states; unjustified exclusions, orphan endpoints, uncovered intents, missing mutation/transcript/command refs; planned-path unknown declaration/wrong role/missing file or scope/semantic drift; and stable diagnostics through core, CLI, and lifecycle including simultaneous failures. Those named cases are not asserted here, so the smoke can PASS while those gate-consumed branches regress. Add focused assertions (or bind truthful existing fresh tests per intent) and narrow any evidence notes to behavior actually exercised.
